semiconductor_relevance: High — Limitek Ltd. is directly involved in the trading and refurbishment of semiconductor equipment, which is crucial for manufacturing processes.
summary: Limitek Ltd. specializes in the trading and refurbishment of pre-owned semiconductor equipment, focusing on categories such as assembly, inspection and measurement, nanotechnology, process, and test equipment. They offer wire bonding equipment and capacitance-to-voltage (CV) probe systems, ensuring quick delivery through a global network.
